definitions.gloss: by item; by category; broken down by heading
definitions.explanation: Organized or classified according to individual items, categories, or headings. Used when data, expenses, tasks, or other information is separated and presented per item rather than as a lump sum or aggregate.

examples.japanese: {項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧。
⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled the expenses by item.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧、⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}できる→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}した→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: I broke down the budget by category and examined where cuts could be made.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集計|しゅうけい}→集計：14598_shuukei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I tabulated the survey results by category and prepared a report.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧ (item, heading, category) and ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate, by). The suffix ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ is highly productive in Japanese and attaches to many nouns to create 'by X' expressions.

Commonly found in business documents, accounting, reports, and administrative contexts. It implies a systematic, organized breakdown of information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to separate by category
- {項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to organize by item
- {項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集計|しゅうけい}→集計：14598_shuukei⟧: tabulation by category
- {項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: itemized budget
- {項目別|こうもくべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: itemized list

SIMILAR WORDS (other ～⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ compounds):
- {種類別|しゅるいべつ}: by type — sorted according to kind or variety
- {年度別|ねんどべつ}: by fiscal year — organized according to annual periods
- ⟦{地域別|ちいきべつ}→地域別：26576_chiikibetsu⟧: by region — broken down by geographic area
